summary: Executed focused backend+frontend regression for taxi Kosovo pricing, single-letter geocode/autocomplete, admin alias auth contract, and startup seed_admin order. All requested runtime behaviors passed on preview URL.
action_items: Review /app/backend/routes/taxi.py decorator placement around /operator/status: current layout appears to attach route decorator to get_favorite_locations while get_operator_status may be undecorated/unreachable.
critical_code_review_comments: Potential routing bug in taxi.py: '@router.get("/operator/status")' is separated from 'get_operator_status' and precedes the favorite-locations handler, likely exposing wrong payload on /operator/status.

Requested startup sequence is present in active server.py: create_indexes() -> seed_admin() -> ensure_admin_driver_account(); seed_admin remains idempotent and refreshes password_hash when environment password changes.
test_credentials: Read and used /app/memory/test_credentials.md admin credentials (canonical + alias).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public preview URL only (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Known external preview edge CORS OPTIONS warnings were acknowledged as infrastructure-level and not marked as app failure.
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced for requested scope. One static RCA candidate found: decorator drift in taxi.py likely introduced during endpoint insert/reorder, causing '/operator/status' decorator to attach to the wrong function.
